source: Builtin data records in declarations, aliases, ARRAYs, local storage, exact ordinary/linked arguments/results and custom PATH node/header structures
qualifiers: GROUP_ASSOC accepts existing constant IN GROUP 1..32 metadata; COMMON_ASSOC does not; no automatic ownership, model or robot discovery
ownership: Whole same-type bare references borrow; grouped records/results copy partial checked data; every scalar-field routine argument is a private value, including USING/indexed/linked calls
protection: No field BYNAME or generic output/entry/status aliases, association FOR counters or timers; direct assignment and declared scalar/aggregate READ remain writable
input: Whole-response checks before data publication; existing text/binary scalar formats, expanded WRITE and checked XML input roots; no native packed word format
variables: Exact GET_VAR/SET_VAR whole data and explicit named scalar copies, CREATE_VAR/ARRAY OF allocation and rename, VAR_INFO type codes 20/30, existing cache/missing/status rules
persistence: Ordinary typed JSON/VR values and creation metadata, including custom PATH and collection ARRAY data; no live aliases, callbacks, suspended frames or robot bindings
limits: Four scalar leaves per record; existing 32767-leaf and 64-schema-level data bounds plus ordinary transfer/input budgets; native bitfield/option domains are not guessed
compatibility: Default/explicit STD_PTH_NODE remain NODE_POS only; COMMON_DATA/GROUP_DATA standard-node fields and automatic environment recording remain unavailable
boundary: Offline data and group intent only; no motion-option application, native ABI, source-form/compiler/controller equivalence or public strict mode
evidence: 120 authored regressions, four runnable examples and two linked projects, with independent full saved-variable rows and typed input expectations
